name: gpu_scheduler
summary: VRAM-aware slot allocator across the dual RTX 3090 Ti rig (24 GB each = 48 GB total). First-fit decreasing — picks the GPU with most free VRAM that can fit. Tracks reservations in-memory; verifies against nvidia-smi on demand.
engine_pattern: Dict[device_id → GPUDevice]. try_reserve(vram_gb) returns Optional[GPUReservation]. release(res) frees the budget. Thread-safe via Lock.
guarantees: Sum of reservations on a device never exceeds total_vram_gb
Released reservations always free their budget
Drift detection via verify_with_nvidia_smi() — warns but does not invalidate
First-fit decreasing → least-loaded GPU gets the next job
usage_example:
from gpu_scheduler import GPUScheduler
s = GPUScheduler()
res = s.try_reserve(16, label='flux_inference')
if res:
    try:
        # run model here
        pass
    finally:
        s.release(res)
